The soft Precedence(door_open, key_lost) correctly captures 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' as a preference.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) hard with Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) hard captures 'open the door, then take the box'; the soft Precedence(door_open, key_lost) matches 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' — the 'try not to' cue makes it soft, and since key_lost is defined only while the door is closed, the plain-Precedence reading (ban ends once door_open happens) matches the task's 'while still closed' condition. No goal, order, or priority is missing, and no clause is redundant or added.
